summary: This Form 6-K is a routine disclosure of a Nasdaq listing deficiency notice. Heidmar Maritime Holdings Corp. (HMR) disclosed that its closing bid price was below $1.00 for 30 consecutive business days, triggering a 180-day grace period through October 19, 2026. The company intends to monitor the price and consider options to regain compliance. This is an ordinary compliance notification with no special-situation event such as a transaction, activist campaign, or restructuring. The business operations are unaffected, and the stock continues trading normally. No action or catalyst is present beyond a timeline to cure the deficiency.
